frase_gancho.texto: From family portraits to the last watermelon she painted shortly before her death.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: The first rooms of the house were the family’s living room. Today they function as a gallery. The works on display may change with the exhibitions, but you will usually find paintings here that Frida made about her family, about politics, and about life. Look at the family tree in Mi familia, the portrait of her father, and the watermelons of Viva la Vida, painted just days before her death.
